DOP: atiyāti pr. 3 sg. [ S. ati√yā], 1. passes by ; Ud-a 318, 27 (~anti); — 2. (re-)enters ; A I 68, 23 (rañño na phāsu hoti ~ātuṃ vā niyyātuṃ vā; Mp II 142, 6 : ~ātun ti bahiddhā janapadacārikaṃ caritvā icchiticchitakkhaṇe anto nagaraṃ pavisituṃ).

(ati + √yā), 1 . to pass by; 3pl. ~yanti [ cf. however sa. ati-yanti], Ud-a 318, 27 ( = 'atikkamanti'). — 2. to ( re ) enter into the town ( said of a king ) ; inf. ~ātuṃ, AN l 68, 23 foll. (bahiddhā janapadacārikaṃ caritvā icchiticchitakkhaṇe anto- nagaraṃ pavisituṃ, Mp; opp. niyyātuṃ).
